statement: The non-canonical header-load skip was removed. When GAMBIT_GC_ORIGIN is set, mark_array commits the tagged scan word, return address, cell, remaining count and processor id before the header load, then still performs that load. A 200-second (go 15 5000) run on gsi UUID 1BCB0A1C-FA73-33E6-8647-F744CA756D24 produced no new SIGSEGV. That absence is not a classification of the saved 22:09 fault and is not a GC/FFI inventory pass.
